note: Putnam County GA (13237). The county GIS server putnamcountygis.com hosts Hosted/Parcels and Hosted/ParcelData FeatureServers, but those hold Putnam County, OHIO parcels (coordinates ~41.08N, -83.89W), not Georgia. The Georgia parcel viewers (qPublic/Schneider, Commission District experience app) are viewer-only, with no public queryable parcel service found; the Boundaries folder has only boundary layers. Commercial parcel sources (Dynamo, Regrid, Rockford) were not used due to licensing.
